0022600136.text: Toronto, now 2-1 and on a one-game losing streak, hosts Orlando, 1-2 and riding a one-game winning streak, in the Raptors' fourth game of the 2026-27 season. The Raptors sit third in the Atlantic, half a game back, and fourth in the East, while the Magic are fourth in the Southeast, 1.5 games back, and 10th in the East. Toronto will be without Brandon Ingram (Achilles, surgery), Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation, averaging 19.5 points and 25.8 minutes per game this season), and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), while Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Raptors won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, most recently beating Orlando 139-87 in Toronto on March 29, 2026.
